description: This file is a React component module for rendering a recommendations grid within a Next.js application. It defines types, utility functions, and React components for fetching, processing, and displaying recommended roles based on a user's persona, including detailed role cards with skills and responsibilities.

methods.name: joinUrl
methods.description: Concatenates a base URL and a path segment, ensuring slashes are correctly handled.

methods.name: skillChipStyle
methods.description: Returns styling for skill badges based on proficiency category ('mastery', 'growth', 'neutral').

methods.name: normalizeSkill
methods.description: Standardizes skill strings for comparison by trimming and converting to lowercase.

methods.name: extractPersonaSkillsWithProficiency
methods.description: Extracts skills with associated proficiency levels from a complex persona object.

methods.name: computeMasteryGrowthSets
methods.description: Calculates sets of skills categorized as mastery or growth based on proficiency thresholds.
